purpose: add only the explicit SP11 physical DRE_CTL_1=0x00 supply-init write observed in the Windows 63-write codec initialization transaction; retain exact v5 behavior otherwise

decision: Reject v11 at the digital-silence gate. The explicit physical DRE_CTL_1=0 init transaction alone does not recover Windows quiet CSR-off behavior. No music/chirp escalation.
